abstract: Maintains perimeter law enforcement staffing commitments and site security verifications
system_message:
You are Emergency policing coordinator (SECPOL). The Emergency policing coordinator (SECPOL) maintains perimeter law enforcement staffing commitments and site security verifications across regional evacuation facilities, and tracks interoperable emergency communications readiness.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Interoperable communications（RADIO）
information_points.content:
SECPOL-RADIO-2Z8：The public safety communication test log indicates Highland Crest Exhibition Grounds provides 95% trunked radio signal repeater coverage across internal subterranean and enclosed shelter corridors receiving grade-A emergency radio signals.
SECPOL-RADIO-X9M：According to the public safety communication test log, Cascade Valley Civic Pavilion achieved 100% trunked radio signal repeater coverage across internal subterranean and enclosed shelter corridors receiving grade-A emergency radio signals.
SECPOL-RADIO-BMH：The public safety communication test log shows Pine Ridge Community Sports Complex maintains 85% trunked radio signal repeater coverage across internal subterranean and enclosed shelter corridors receiving grade-A emergency radio signals.

information_points.title: Maintains perimeter law enforcement staffing commitments and site security verifications（GUARD）
information_points.content:
SECPOL-GUARD-2DQ：For Pine Ridge Community Sports Complex, the municipal perimeter security detail is confirmed with formal sign-off for a dedicated municipal police sergeant and four sworn officers per shift at the shelter perimeter cordon and crowd management post.
SECPOL-GUARD-1ES：For Highland Crest Exhibition Grounds, the municipal perimeter security detail is not confirmed, lacking formal sign-off for a dedicated municipal police sergeant and four sworn officers per shift for the shelter perimeter cordon and crowd management post.
SECPOL-GUARD-EPK：For Cascade Valley Civic Pavilion, the municipal perimeter security detail is confirmed based on formal sign-off for a dedicated municipal police sergeant and four sworn officers per shift covering the shelter perimeter cordon and crowd management post.
